posts.title: Visualization "Transcultural Empire Peoplespace"
posts.subtitle: Iinteractive explorer of two historical census datasets from Russian Empire and Soviet Union.
posts.excerpt: From Russian Empire subjects to Soviet citizens, this project illustrates the population and methodology changes with historical maps and tables using data from the 1897 and 1926 censuses
posts.version: public beta (tool) and AI-draft (this page text)

posts.title: Visualization "American Presidents - Lifetimes & Service"
posts.subtitle: Circular lifetime glyphs for U.S. presidents life arcs
posts.excerpt: An interactive recreation of the Roman Emperors circular lifetime chart applied to U.S. presidents. We can see lifespan arcs, terms in office, and manner-of-death. Work is scalable for other historical periods.
posts.version: public beta (tool), public alpha (dataset), and AI-draft (this page text)

posts.title: Visualization "Ukraine's bloody tool"
posts.subtitle: Daily casualty estimates reported by each belligerent party for the opposing side since February 2022
posts.excerpt: This work illustrates cross-reported casualty estimates from the daily briefings of the respective military authorities, with each side reporting estimates of the other’s casualties. It also discusses the methodology and limitations of the reported data.

posts.title: Visualization "Building taxonomy"
posts.subtitle: Simplified building taxonomy of selected cities
posts.excerpt: A minimalist small-multiple grid visualizing the 100 most geometrically complex buildings in each city, computed from OpenStreetMap building geometries.

posts.title: Visualization "Rulers of the World" - Kazakh Khanate
posts.subtitle: Timeline visualization of Kazakh Khan rulers by year
posts.excerpt: A stripe-based timeline chart showing years of rule, periods of stability, and transitions of power in the Kazakh Khanate. Jupyter Notebook poster plus an interactive browser tool.
posts.version: public beta (tool), alpha (preset datasets), and AI-draft (this page text)
